messages:
anya: thinking out loud — we should try a sampling approach to estimate per-invocation token cost + net cache savings instead of trying to record everything. sketch: sample ~0.5% of invocations and capture full econ telemetry for those. thoughts?

matt: agree in principle. main risk is sampling bias — some routes/tenants have very different token distributions. we should stratify by route and model_sku. also consider sticky sampling per tenant so time-series are stable.

jo: +1. for cache savings we need to capture KV-cache hit/miss counts and which prefix hashes were present. sampling must capture: model_sku, route, tenant_id_bucket, seq_len, token_counts, kv_hits. don't capture raw prompt text (privacy).

anya: good call on privacy. how feasible is sticky tenant buckets? do we need a deterministic hash on tenant id and use lowest bits to pick bucket?

matt: yep — deterministic hashing is cheap. bucket assignment lives in the edge proxy so it's consistent across retries/regions. sample_rate config example: `sample_rate: 0.005` and `bucketing_bits: 8` so each tenant maps to 256 buckets, pick first N buckets per rollout.

ux-sam: for console UX — we should show sampled estimates with a clear confidence indicator, and an explicit badge: "sampled estimate (n=12.3k, 95% CI)". also a toggle: Show raw sampled rows vs aggregated estimate. folks get confused between sampled and exact.

matt: implementation note — attributing cache savings: record for each sampled request the observed #tokens_saved_by_cache (or 0), and the model variant used. Then aggregate per-route and subtract baseline no-cache cost. for chained requests (multi-model), record per-model token deltas.

cost-analytics-bot: created issue #456: sampled-econ-infra — includes schema, ingestion pipeline, and dashboard mocks. (link: https://rwd/issue/456) :white_check_mark:

infra-bot: deploy queued: sample-econ-probe v1 -> staging at 2026-03-20T14:32:00Z.

jo: privacy/security: ensure any stored hashes are irreversible (salted hash) and that we strip prompt/response content. add KMS-tag to the sampled table for lifecycle rules. PII must never touch analytic cluster.

anya: rollout proposal: start with global 0.5% for 48h to validate pipeline, then move to stratified sampling: 0.1% for low-traffic routes, 2% for top-100 routes (for better CI). also enable tenant sticky buckets for long-lived tenants.

matt: estimate storage & CPU: if we sample 0.5% of 1B daily invocations -> 5M sampled rows. each row ~1.2KB compressed -> ~6GB/day, plus processing. pipeline should be fine but we should cap retention to 30d by default and provide on-demand archival.

ux-sam: console wording suggestion: "Estimated per-invocation unit cost (sampled). Confidence: 95% CI shown. Sampling rate: 0.5% — enable 'exact mode' for paid customers with reserved telemetry." also add hover tooltip linking to docs about how sampling works.

anya: action items: (1) matt + jo to draft schema + ingestion (issue #456), (2) infra to provision staging retention & KMS tagging, (3) ux-sam to mock dashboard badge + tooltip, (4) legal to sign off on sampling privacy blurb. i'll spin up a short RFC tomorrow. thanks everyone :raised_hands:

matt: thanks — I'll drop a short PR with sample config and a provenance flag so downstream can mark "sampled" rows.

jo: adding note — watch out for correlated retries inflating kv_hit counts; dedupe by invocation_id when possible.

anya: noted. closing for now, will post RFC link when ready.
